domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions so subtraction can be performed on like units.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are converted to like denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with a 0-fraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping or post-subtraction simplification steps.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a 0-fraction, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when the solver explicitly restructures a quantity into separate whole and fractional parts to make subtraction components compatible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between fractions; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag direct subtraction of already compatible parts; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun or final simplification; those belong to S04.

skills.name: Subtract compatible parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once quantities are in compatible form by subtracting like-denominator fractions and/or the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators of fractions with a shared denominator are subtracted.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when subtraction produces an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting steps such as finding common denominators or rewriting whole numbers; those belong to S01 or S02.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping adjustment itself; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-formatting-only steps after the subtraction is complete; those belong to S04.

skills.name: Regroup and finalize
skills.definition: Borrow across whole and fractional parts when needed and express the result in lowest terms or appropriate final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a result is simplified, such as reducing a fraction, converting 0 over a denominator to 0, or omitting a zero fractional part.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps before any regrouping or final reduction; those belong to S03.
Do not tag initial normalization of whole numbers or improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion; that belongs to S01.
